description: A second view of the same city at sunset — the mushroom-topped building and the green pavilion stand under swirling purple clouds and a warm red-orange sky
description_zh: 同一座城市的黄昏景色——蘑菇顶建筑与绿色长条亭馆静立其间，上方是盘旋的紫色云团和暖橘红色的天空

images.caption: The same mushroom-capped orange building and green pavilion reappear, but now beneath swirling dark-purple clouds and a blazing red-orange sunset. A red-striped road runs along the bottom; no castle or creatures this time — a quieter, moodier take on the city
images.caption_zh: 同样的橙色蘑菇顶建筑与绿色长条亭馆再次出现，但这一次上方是盘旋的深紫云团与炽烈的橘红色落日。画面底部是一条红色条纹的路；没有城堡也没有小生灵——一个更宁静、更富情绪的城市视角

title: Undersea Tunnel
description: Two chalkboard panels lying on the floor: the top shows a big robot or submarine silhouette with red flower stickers; the bottom shows a long undersea tunnel with sparkling gem details
description_zh: 两块平铺在地上的黑板：上方一个巨大的机器人或潜艇轮廓，点缀着红色花朵贴纸；下方是一条长长的海底隧道，嵌着闪亮的宝石装饰

images.caption: Two chalkboard panels laid flat on the floor. The top panel features a big round-bodied figure — perhaps a submarine or friendly robot — outlined in purple chalk, flanked by a cluster of red flower stickers. The bottom panel shows a long horizontal tunnel composed of stacked capsules, decorated with a tiny gem sticker — an undersea train or submarine tunnel. Yoga is visible in the corner, mid-drawing
images.caption_zh: 两块黑板平铺在地上。上板是一个圆身大怪物——可能是潜艇或友好机器人——用紫色粉笔勾勒，旁边还贴着一簇红色花朵贴纸。下板画着一条由多节车厢组成的长长隧道，点缀着一颗宝石小贴纸——像是一条海底火车或潜艇通道。角落里可以看到正在画画的 Yoga

title: Big-Head Boy and Tall Tower
description: A towering multi-story chalk house rises above a tiny street lined with small castles, a ladder and a lone figure — chalk fantasy architecture
description_zh: 黑板上一座层层叠叠的高塔房屋俯瞰着下方的小街道，街上排列着几座小尖顶城堡、一个小人和一架梯子——粉笔画成的幻想建筑

images.caption: A large multi-story house dominates the top of the board with round and square windows and a tiny front door; a swirling cloud floats to its right. Below, a long street hosts a row of small triangle-roofed castles, a solitary stick figure, and a small ladder, with a checkered rug tucked into the bottom-left corner
images.caption_zh: 画面顶部是一座庞大的多层房屋，满布圆窗方窗，正面还有一扇小门；房屋右侧飘着一团螺旋状云朵。下方是一条长长的街道，街上排列着几座三角尖顶的小城堡、一个孤单的小人、一架小梯子，左下角还藏着一张格纹小地毯

title: House and Train
description: Two chalkboard panels — a large windowed house and a fish-faced creature on the left, a long train carriage and a small alien sticker on the right
description_zh: 两块黑板并排：左板画着一座布满窗户的大房子，下方一个鱼脸大怪物；右板是一节长长的火车车厢，旁边贴着一个外星小人

images.caption: Left panel: a tall house with a triangular roof, round and square windows and a chimney sits at the top; below it a round-bodied creature with big eyes and a little mouth takes over most of the board. Right panel: a long rectangular train or bus with many windows stretches across the top, and a brightly colored little alien sticker perches next to two chalk-drawn pillars
images.caption_zh: 左板：顶部是一座三角尖顶的大房子，圆窗方窗和一根烟囱一应俱全；下方整个黑板被一个圆身子大眼睛小嘴巴的怪物占据。右板：顶部横着一辆长方形的火车或公交车，车身布满窗格；旁边还贴着一个彩色的外星人小贴纸，立在两根粉笔柱旁边

title: Tall Towers and Saturn
description: An in-progress chalkboard scene — a stack of tall tower buildings on the left, a ringed planet and spacecraft on the right, photographed with Yoga sitting on the floor
description_zh: 黑板作画进行中的一幕——左边一叠高耸的塔楼建筑，右边是一颗带环的星球和一艘飞船，照片里 Yoga 正盘腿坐在地毯上

images.caption: Two chalkboard panels. Left panel: a tall stack of multi-story towers with many windows and doors, decorated with red-flower stickers and a small rainbow block. Right panel: a ringed planet (like Saturn) floats at the top with a rocket-shaped ship below, accompanied by red-flower stickers. Yoga sits cross-legged on a teal rug in his pajamas, with a red chalk box beside him
images.caption_zh: 两块黑板并排。左板：一叠多层高塔，窗户和小门密密麻麻，旁边贴着几朵红色小花和一块彩虹小方块。右板：顶部飘着一颗带光环的星球（像土星），下方是一艘火箭形状的小飞船，同样点缀着红花贴纸。Yoga 穿着睡衣盘腿坐在青绿色圆地毯上，身旁是一盒红色粉笔

title: House and Bus
description: Two chalkboard panels: a big house with a giant round-bodied creature on the left, a long bus and a little alien sticker on the right
description_zh: 两块黑板：左板画着一座大房子和一个占满半边板的圆身大怪物；右板画着一辆长长的公交车，旁边贴着一个外星小人

images.caption: Left panel: a tall house with a peaked roof, a chimney puffing into a large cloud, round and square windows and a front door; beneath it a round-bodied creature with two big eyes and a tiny mouth spans most of the lower half. Right panel: a long rectangular bus or carriage runs across the top with many evenly-spaced windows, and a small alien sticker perches beside two white chalk pillars
images.caption_zh: 左板：一座尖顶大房子，烟囱上冒出一团大云，墙上是圆窗方窗和一扇正门；下方大半块黑板被一个圆身子、两只大眼睛、一张小嘴的怪物占据。右板：顶部是一辆长方形公交车，整齐排列着许多小窗，旁边贴着一个外星人小贴纸，立在两根白色粉笔柱之间

title: Toy House
description: Chalkboard scene of a tall toy house with many windows and antennas, a long vehicle, and a small castle — a whole little neighborhood in white and pastel chalk
description_zh: 黑板上的玩具家场景：一座布满窗户和天线的高塔房屋、一辆长长的汽车、还有一座小城堡，构成一片粉笔勾勒的小街区

images.caption: Left panel shows a long cylindrical vehicle with round wheels and a small tent-shaped structure below. Right panel is the main event: a stacked multi-story toy house with round and square windows, a pointed roof, antennas, a backpack-sticker character, a street with tiny cars and a small castle at the very bottom
images.caption_zh: 左板画着一辆长圆筒汽车，车轮是圆圈，下面是一座小帐篷建筑。右板是主角：一座层层叠叠的玩具家高塔，圆窗方窗布满其上，尖顶屋顶配着天线，身旁站着一个背书包的小人贴纸，底部是一条街道和一座小城堡

title: Rainy Day Umbrellas
description: Mixed-media collage of grey storm clouds raining over three paper umbrellas against a vivid orange-and-yellow painted sky
description_zh: 混合媒介拼贴画，灰色乌云在鲜艳的橙黄色天空下降雨，三把纸雨伞撑在雨中

images.caption: Two large grey paper clouds sit near the top of a bright orange-and-yellow painted background, with short green brushstrokes falling as rain; below, three umbrellas made from crinkled brown and tan paper are arranged in a row, each with a curled orange clay or paper handle
images.caption_zh: 两片灰色纸质乌云贴在明亮的橙黄色涂绘背景上方，绿色短笔触化作雨滴落下；下方三把用褐色和棕色褶皱纸做成的雨伞依次排列，每把都带有弯曲的橙色把手

title: Nemo Clownfish
description: Bold oil painting of two orange clownfish swimming among coral and sea anemones in a dark underwater scene
description_zh: 大胆的油画风格，两条橙色小丑鱼在深色海底的珊瑚和海葵间游弋

images.caption: Two bright orange clownfish with white vertical stripes and black eyes swim in a dark underwater scene; to the left, tall red coral with pink bubble-like tips and a green-red sea anemone fill the background, while olive-green seaweed tendrils wind along the bottom against patches of deep blue water
images.caption_zh: 两条明亮的橙色小丑鱼身上带有白色竖条纹和黑色眼睛，在深色海底游动；左侧红色珊瑚顶端点缀着粉色气泡状圆点，一朵红绿色的海葵填满背景，橄榄绿的海草沿底部蜿蜒，衬着深蓝色的海水

title: Cardboard Tank Battalion
description: Mixed-media craft combining cardboard construction and marker drawings to create a tank battle scene with buildings and terrain
description_zh: 混合媒介手工作品，用硬纸板拼搭和马克笔绘画组合出坦克战斗场景，配有房屋和地形

images.caption: A long cardboard tank with folded brown cardboard treads runs across the bottom; above it, white paper shows a printed tank reference image on the left, hand-drawn houses and a large vehicle outline in black marker in the center, and blue marker roads and a lamppost on the right, with red-bordered label stickers and a Good Work car sticker scattered throughout
images.caption_zh: 一辆用折叠棕色硬纸板做履带的长坦克横跨底部；上方白纸上左侧有一张打印的坦克参考图，中间用黑色马克笔手绘了房屋和大型车辆轮廓，右侧用蓝色马克笔画了道路和路灯，红框标签贴纸和小汽车贴纸散布其间

images.caption: A wider view showing the full cardboard tank extending across the scene with an even longer row of folded cardboard treads; the upper section features multiple hand-drawn tanks in black marker alongside printed tank reference images, a large cannon barrel extending to the right, and red-bordered label stickers marking different sections of the battlefield
images.caption_zh: 更宽的全景视角展示了整个硬纸板坦克横跨画面，更长一排折叠纸板履带；上方有多辆黑色马克笔手绘坦克与打印的坦克参考图并列，一根大炮管向右延伸，红框标签贴纸标注着战场的不同区域

images.caption: Yoga sits cross-legged on a teal carpet in pajamas, carefully working on his cardboard tank craft, gluing and assembling the piece with scissors, glue stick, and paper scattered around him
images.caption_zh: Yoga穿着睡衣盘腿坐在青色地毯上，正专注地制作他的硬纸板坦克手工，身旁散落着剪刀、胶棒和纸张

title: High-Speed Train Station
description: Chalkboard drawing of a red high-speed train arriving at a station with a waiting passenger and overhead power lines
description_zh: 黑板画，一辆红色高铁进站，站台上有等候的乘客和架空电线

images.caption: A tall vertical chalkboard scene: at the bottom, a large red and pink high-speed train drawn in chalk with white outlines arrives at a yellow platform, its rounded nose facing the viewer; overhead white chalk power lines stretch across; a small cartoon boy sticker stands at the station; above in the dark sky, white and pink magnetic block shapes are scattered, and three red flower magnets mark the left side
images.caption_zh: 竖幅黑板画：底部一辆用粉红色和白色粉笔画的大型高铁正面进站，圆润的车头朝向观者，黄色站台在下方；头顶白色粉笔架空电线横跨；一个卡通男孩贴纸站在站台上；上方深色天空中散落着白色和粉色磁力片形状，左侧有三朵红花磁铁

images.caption: Yoga stands with his back to the camera in a white tank top, drawing on the large black chalkboard wall with chalk, adding details to his high-speed train artwork; a picture book lies open on the floor beside him for reference
images.caption_zh: Yoga穿着白色背心背对镜头站着，正用粉笔在大黑板墙上作画，为他的高铁作品添加细节；地上旁边摊开一本图画书作为参考

title: Clay Seahorse and Elephant
description: Mixed-media artwork with sculpted clay animals placed on a painted canvas background of green, blue, and warm earth tones
description_zh: 混合媒介立体作品，用黏土塑的动物放置在绿色、蓝色和暖色调涂绘的画布背景上

images.caption: A canvas with a bright green painted border frames a soft pastel background of blue-grey and yellow washes; on top sits an orange clay seahorse with segmented ridges and a curled tail, alongside a white clay elephant with spread legs, both standing out three-dimensionally against the flat painted surface
images.caption_zh: 一块画布上鲜绿色涂绘的边框围着蓝灰和黄色水彩般的柔和背景；上面立着一只橙色黏土海马，身体有分段纹理和卷曲的尾巴，旁边是一只白色黏土大象，四腿张开，两者在平面画布上呈现立体效果

images.caption: A close-up angled view of the same artwork showing the textured details of the orange seahorse with a blue dot eye and the white elephant with sculpted trunk and legs, the painted canvas beneath revealing layers of green, grey, black, yellow, and a hint of red brushwork
images.caption_zh: 同一作品的近距离斜角视图，展示橙色海马的纹理细节和蓝色圆点眼睛，以及白色大象雕塑的象鼻和四肢，下方画布显露出绿色、灰色、黑色、黄色和一抹红色的笔触层次

title: Room Collage Gallery
description: Vibrant collage of cut-out miniature room scenes and objects layered over an orange and red painted background
description_zh: 色彩鲜艳的拼贴画，各种剪裁的迷你房间场景和物品层叠在橙红色涂绘背景上

images.caption: A busy collage on an orange-and-red painted background filled with dozens of small cut-out images: miniature bookshelves, potted plants, furniture, a butterfly, flowers, a cat on a red sofa, framed pictures, a window scene, and various household objects, all overlapping in a joyful chaotic arrangement with touches of green, blue, yellow, and pink throughout
images.caption_zh: 橙红色涂绘背景上铺满了数十个小剪贴图片的热闹拼贴画：迷你书架、盆栽植物、家具、蝴蝶、花朵、红沙发上的猫、相框画、窗户场景和各种家居物品，全部以欢快的层叠方式排列，点缀着绿色、蓝色、黄色和粉色

title: Stormy Sea Adventure
description: Expressive marker drawing of a smiling figure amid crashing blue waves and buildings, drawn while having a fever
description_zh: 发烧时画的充满表现力的马克笔画，一个微笑的人物在蓝色巨浪和建筑物中冒险

images.caption: Bold marker drawing on white paper: sweeping black wavy lines fill the top like storm clouds; below, large blue and green marker waves crash across the page; a small smiling yellow face with a red circle outline stands in the center; to the right, blue marker sketches of buildings, scaffolding-like structures, and a pink-red object at the bottom add to the energetic composition
images.caption_zh: 白纸上大胆的马克笔画：顶部黑色波浪线如暴风云密布；下方蓝色和绿色马克笔画的巨浪翻涌；中间站着一个带红色圆圈轮廓的黄色笑脸小人；右侧有蓝色马克笔画的建筑物、脚手架般的结构，底部一个粉红色物体，整体构图充满能量

title: Foam Ball Planets
description: Mixed-media cosmic scene of orange-crowned foam-ball planets set into swirling green paint with clay creatures and yellow star dots on a black canvas
description_zh: 综合材料创作的宇宙场景，黑色画布上翻卷的绿色油彩里嵌着一颗颗带橙色环冠的泡沫球星球，四周有紫色黏土小生物和黄色星点。

images.caption: Five foam-ball planets ringed with thick orange clay sit inside swirling deep green paint on a black canvas, flanked by purple clay dragons and cats, with yellow paint dots scattered like distant stars.
images.caption_zh: 黑色画布上，五颗被厚厚橙色黏土环绕的泡沫球星球躺在翻卷的深绿色油彩里，旁边有紫色黏土小龙和小猫，四散的黄色油彩点像遥远的星星。

images.caption: Process photo — Yoga in a paint-splattered smock at Long Studio, brush in hand, painting one of the foam balls in a black tray before assembling the piece.
images.caption_zh: 过程照——Yoga穿着沾满颜料的画衣，在龙工作室里手握画笔，正把一颗颗泡沫球在黑色托盘里涂上颜色，再拼成完整作品。

images.caption: Later stage of the same piece — the foam-ball planets now sprout tall red, orange and black incense-stick antennae, and more purple clay creatures have crawled onto the canvas.
images.caption_zh: 同一作品的后续阶段——每颗泡沫球星球都插上了高高的红色、橙色、黑色小棒当天线，画布上又爬上来更多紫色黏土小生物。

title: Snowfield Robot
description: Clay picture of a red-and-brown boxy robot with big yellow-and-purple eyes standing in a field of blue snowballs
description_zh: 黏土画：一个红棕方框、身体是一排红色泥条的机器人，睁着大大的黄紫色眼睛，站在一片蓝色雪球组成的雪地里。

images.caption: A chunky robot made from rolled clay strips — brown-and-red rectangular frame body, yellow round eyes with purple pupils, a small yellow question-mark tail — surrounded by dozens of pale blue clay balls representing snow.
images.caption_zh: 用揉成条的黏土拼出的方块机器人：棕红色矩形身体，黄色圆眼配紫色瞳孔，旁边有个黄色小问号尾巴，四周散落着几十颗浅蓝色黏土球，代表雪。

title: Deep-Sea Submarine
description: Chalkboard drawing of a twin-hulled submarine decorated with alphabet stickers, sea-creature stickers, and satellite stickers overhead
description_zh: 黑板画：一艘双身潜艇，船身贴着字母贴纸和海洋生物贴纸，头顶还有卫星贴纸。

images.caption: Twin-hulled submarine drawn in white chalk across two blackboard panels, decked out with alphabet stickers spelling PWFHD, a hot-air-balloon-style column rising above, and satellite and boy-with-cap stickers floating in the space above.
images.caption_zh: 白色粉笔在两扇黑板上画出一艘双身潜艇，船身用字母贴纸拼出P W F H D，头顶还有热气球式塔柱，上方漂着卫星和戴帽小男孩贴纸。

images.caption: Process photo — Yoga standing at the double chalkboard, arranging alphabet stickers onto the submarine drawing he's building.
images.caption_zh: 过程照——Yoga站在双面黑板前，正把字母贴纸一颗颗贴到他画的潜艇上。

title: Undersea Explorer
description: Chalkboard scene of a boy explorer above a deep-sea world of coral, shells, and sea creatures, with a rainbow bead trail winding down through the water
description_zh: 黑板画：一个小小探险家高高站在海底世界之上，下方有珊瑚、贝壳、海洋生物贴纸，还有一串彩色圆珠像水流一样蜿蜒穿过。

images.caption: Tall chalkboard composition — cap-wearing boy sticker up top under a satellite, giant blue chalk-drawn shell in the middle, yellow chalk coral fan, sea-creature stickers, and an arc of rainbow beads (green-orange-red-blue-orange) tracing a diver's path down.
images.caption_zh: 细长的黑板构图——顶部戴帽的小男孩贴纸紧挨着卫星，中间是巨大的蓝色粉笔贝壳，旁边是黄色的粉笔珊瑚扇，四周贴着各种海洋生物贴纸，一串绿橙红蓝橙的彩色圆珠像潜水员的路线一样从上蜿蜒而下。

title: Sprout House & Seeds
description: Marker drawing of a lopsided sprout-shaped house with stick-figure sprout people inside and out, and scattered black seeds on the ground
description_zh: 马克笔画：一座歪歪扭扭的豆芽形房子，里外站着一群豆芽小人，地上散落着黑色的种子。

images.caption: Cut-out white paper drawing in black marker — a bumpy, lopsided house with two sprout-headed figures on the roof (one waving), a big sad-eyed sprout inside, three stick sprouts to the right with round black heads, and orange-red scribbled seeds spilled across the bottom.
images.caption_zh: 白纸剪裁的马克笔画——一座凹凸不平、歪歪的房子，屋顶上站着两个豆芽头小人（一个在挥手），屋内画着一个眼睛垂垂的大豆芽，右边是三个圆头黑豆芽小人，下方散落着橙红色涂鸦种子。

title: Animal City Bus
description: Chalkboard drawing of a plumed bus marked "MKB" with animal and food stickers riding inside
description_zh: 黑板画：一辆头顶蓬松羽饰的巴士，车身写着"MKB"，动物和食物贴纸像乘客一样坐在车里。

images.caption: White chalk drawing of a chunky bus with a leafy white plume on top, blue-and-red "MKB" letter stickers on the front, animal stickers (turtle, fish, flower, chick) riding as passengers behind the windows, colored button wheels, and a cap-wearing boy sticker up top.
images.caption_zh: 白色粉笔画的方头巴士，车顶顶着一大簇白色羽毛，车头贴着蓝红字母"MKB"，窗户后面"坐着"乌龟、鱼、花朵、小鸡等动物贴纸当乘客，彩色圆点是车轮，画面最上方还有一个戴帽小男孩贴纸。

title: Twin Submarine Combined
description: Duplo brick build of two submarines fused into one machine, with a pink dome cockpit, a white door, and a stacked colorful hull
description_zh: 乐高得宝积木搭的"双潜水艇合体"——玫红色圆顶驾驶舱、白色小门、拼色的多层船身。

images.caption: Overhead view of the tall Duplo build in progress on the desk — a spine of stacked bricks (blue, gray, green, orange, yellow) rises out of the wide multicolored base, with Yoga's hand steadying the top.
images.caption_zh: 俯拍进行中的乐高得宝作品——一根由蓝、灰、绿、橙、黄积木层层堆起的"脊柱"从多彩宽底座上竖起来，Yoga的手正扶着最顶端。

images.caption: Side view — the finished twin sub sits on the desk showing an open blue-and-orange hold up top, a magenta arch mid-body, a white-and-blue window brick, and colorful bricks packed tight in the base.
images.caption_zh: 侧面视角——完成后的双潜水艇立在桌上，顶部是敞开的蓝橙货舱，中部横着玫红色弧形块，一块白蓝相间的窗块嵌在腰身，底部塞满了各种彩色积木。

images.caption: Another angle — the assembled sub from behind, revealing a small blue-and-white square window on the upper hull and the yellow slope brick that forms the stern.
images.caption_zh: 换个角度——从后方看这艘拼好的潜艇，上层船身有一块蓝白相间的方形小窗，船尾是一块黄色斜坡积木。

images.caption: Yoga proudly holds the finished machine up to the camera — a pink dome cockpit crowns a white-doored cabin over a chunky orange, blue and yellow hull.
images.caption_zh: Yoga把完成的作品高高举向镜头——玫红圆顶驾驶舱扣在开着白色小门的舱室上，下方是敦实的橙、蓝、黄色船身。

title: Rainbow Duplo Well
description: Duplo brick water well with a paper cup dangling from a pulley, watched over by a gray elephant and a green dinosaur
description_zh: 乐高得宝积木搭的水井——一只纸杯从横梁上的滑轮吊下，旁边站着灰色小象和绿色小恐龙守护。

images.caption: Rainbow Duplo well on a green baseplate — a paper cup hangs on a yellow-handled winch between two towers, and a gray elephant figurine stands inside a small yellow fenced pen alongside a wooden log stack.
images.caption_zh: 绿色底板上一座彩色乐高水井——两座柱子中间架着一只带黄色转柄的绞盘，一只纸杯挂在上面；灰色小象站在旁边黄色小围栏里，身边堆着几段木头。

images.caption: Closer view — the winch cup is being reeled up, a panda-decorated cup pattern showing; the elephant and a green dinosaur watch from below, with Yoga's face just visible behind the tower.
images.caption_zh: 近景——绞盘上的杯子正被拉起，上面能看到熊猫图案；小象和绿色小恐龙在下方仰头看，Yoga的脸在积木塔后隐约可见。

images.caption: Fully assembled version stands tall on the table — colorful brick body with a striped mid-band, the cup dangling from the yellow winch, and the elephant, dinosaur and orange cones arranged like a small farmyard scene at the base.
images.caption_zh: 完全搭好的版本在桌上高高矗立——彩色积木身体中段是条纹带，纸杯挂在黄色绞盘下，底部小象、恐龙和橙色路锥围成一个小农场场景。

title: Duplo Submarine
description: Chunky Duplo submarine built low and wide, with cannon ports along the front and stacked color bands as the hull
description_zh: 又矮又宽的乐高得宝潜水艇，正面开着一排炮口，船身是层层叠叠的彩色积木。

images.caption: Side view of the low, wide Duplo submarine — the deck is a solid slab of orange, blue, yellow, gray and white bricks, with a small step-up cockpit near the bow.
images.caption_zh: 低而宽的乐高潜水艇侧视——甲板由橙、蓝、黄、灰、白色积木整齐拼成一大块平板，靠船头处有一小段抬起的驾驶室。

images.caption: Top-down view — a yellow chair-shaped brick sits like a captain's seat in the center hollow, with a dark-green ridge running along one side.
images.caption_zh: 俯视图——中间凹槽里放着一块黄色椅子造型的积木，像是船长座椅，一侧还有一条墨绿色的"栏杆"。

images.caption: Front view — three round dark-teal cannon barrels poke out through the front of the hull, framed by gray, yellow, orange and blue bricks stacked around them.
images.caption_zh: 正面视角——船首伸出三根圆圆的墨绿色炮管，四周用灰、黄、橙、蓝色积木堆出炮座。

title: Duplo Battleship Tower
description: Towering Duplo warship built vertically, with a colorful staggered brick body reaching high above the table
description_zh: 垂直搭起的乐高得宝舰艇高塔——彩色积木错落堆叠，一路向上冲得很高。

images.caption: A tall, staggered Duplo battleship rises off the marble table — orange, white, brown, red, yellow and blue bricks step outward at every layer, building a top-heavy tower held together by pure kid engineering.
images.caption_zh: 一座高高的乐高得宝舰艇塔从大理石桌面上拔地而起——橙、白、棕、红、黄、蓝色积木每一层都错开外扩，堆出一座上大下小、全凭小小工程师手法撑起来的塔。

title: Magenta Cannon
description: Chalkboard drawing of a magenta cannon with a blue-and-orange striped barrel pointed up at the sky
description_zh: 黑板画：一门玫红色的大炮，蓝橙条纹的炮管高高指向天空。

images.caption: Bold magenta chalk cannon on a black board — a stepped platform holds a long striped barrel (blue rectangles topped with orange) aimed skyward, with round wheels along the base and red flower stickers floating like puffs of smoke in the upper corner.
images.caption_zh: 黑板上一门粗大的洋红色粉笔大炮——阶梯形炮台上斜架着一根蓝橙相间的长炮管指向天空，炮座下方是一排圆圆的车轮，画面左上角飘着几朵红花贴纸，像是硝烟。

images.caption: Process photo — Yoga sits cross-legged on the floor in bear-print pajamas, drawing the cannon on the chalkboard, with Mario-and-Peach floor mats beside him.
images.caption_zh: 过程照——穿着小熊图案睡衣的Yoga盘腿坐在地上，正在黑板上画这门大炮，身边铺着马力欧和碧琪公主的地垫。
